context:
The holdings value report must subtract what you already sold, or it overstates your holdings. The lane checked Downloads: the July order list there is Banchi's own sales, and the OrderWand sale rows are all Banchi's (892 of 892). Neither has your investment-buy sales.
Without the right file, the report can still ship, labeled 'units sold unknown'.
ref: item 20 (holdings watch), mailaudit holdings value report
steps: Find or download the TCGplayer sales export that covers your investment-buy sales.
Put it in ~/Downloads, and say its file name in the note.
Or say 'ship it labeled' to run the report without it.
title: Which TCGplayer sales export holds the sales of your investment buys?
